policy: Every installed media file must be either an exact rights-cleared public source asset or a deterministic original editorial/evidence composition with its evidentiary source identified. AI-generated and synthetic documentary imagery are prohibited.
limits: Non-AI status is established from institutional provenance, historical dates, work-level records and inspectable deterministic repository rendering, not from unreliable visual AI detectors.

counts.note: Public build: records for unreleased or uninstalled files are left out.

records.title: Field Load Score explainer
records.creator: Rayven-Nikkita Collins
records.alt: A transparent four-part evidence graphic separating sleep pressure, sensory load, social evaluation and physical demand.
records.relevance: Explains the package’s four-part field-load model without pretending a photograph can visualize an unmeasured nervous-system state.
records.nonAiBasis: Hand-authored repository SVG made from text and geometric primitives; its inspectable XML contains no embedded raster image or generative-model artifact.
records.transformation: Original vector evidence design; not documentary photography.

records.title: Runway show
records.creator: Ahmad Ardity
records.alt: A fashion model walking a lit runway while spectators watch from both sides.
records.relevance: A runway combines light, movement, spectatorship and navigation; the image does not measure exposure.
records.nonAiBasis: The canonical institutional collection record identifies a catalogued historical object and its reusable rights status; the local file is a source download, not a generated image.
records.transformation: Source download reduced only when needed for efficient delivery; display crops occur in deterministic platform rendering.
